operators.name: log_softmax_dim
semantics: Computes numerically stable log_softmax along the specified dim (0 for this task).
For each index along dim, outputs log(exp(x - max)/sum(exp(x - max))) using per-slice max subtraction and log-sum-exp to avoid overflow.
Applies to full tensor; the reduction dimension has size 8192, the other dimension 512.
Output has same shape as input, contiguous in memory.

operators.name: cat_dim
semantics: Concatenates input_a and input_b along the specified dim (0).
For dim=0, output rows 0..8191 are input_a, rows 8192..16383 are input_b.
Preserves original memory order of each input block.
Output is contiguous with shape equal to the sum of input sizes along dim.
Performs log_softmax over dim=0 on input x of shape [8192,512].
Numerically stable calculation with max subtraction and log-sum-exp.
Performs log_softmax over dim=0 on input y of shape [8192,512].
Numerically stable calculation with max subtraction and log-sum-exp.
Concatenates the two log_softmax outputs along dim=0.
First half corresponds to x, second half to y.
